description: Get one of the signed-in user's experiments in full (protocol, verdict + summary, and check-in responses) by its id. When `safetyAction` is set, relay its `instruction` first. A paused experiment with a pausing `safetyAction` restarts only on the restart record its `restartRequires` names (a clinician who advised the restart, a documented clearance for a serious event, or an agreed timing schedule), entered with supstack_experiment_restart (or on the web dashboard or with the SupStack assistant, `restartRoute`). An answer chosen by mistake is corrected with supstack_experiment_correct (`correctionRoute`). When `statusHold` is set, the next dose is held until an answer is clear: relay `updateAnswer.how`, and when `updateAnswer.chosenAnswers` is set, tell the user which answer they chose and when it was saved (`chosenAt`, or that the date is unknown when it is null), and relay `updateAnswer.confirmNow`: the saved answer is not a current one, so ask what is happening now (it was chosen in a check-in that was not submitted, perhaps on another device). Relay `medicineConflict` when present. Relay `note` too: the pause is of the optional supplement experiment only. Owner call O-6: when `held` is true, the app refuses its restart whatever record is sent (`heldRefusal.error`: permanently_excluded or app_restart_unavailable): relay `heldRefusal` first, word for word (`heldRefusal.refusal`: `urgentLead` as the heading, then each of `actions` and `hold`, or `heldRefusal.message` when there is no `refusal`, then `heldRefusal.footer`), and do not ask for a restart record. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiments_get
